description: Upload a file (any type: image, audio, video, PDF, etc.) to Google Drive, either from a local path on the server or from base64-encoded content. When fileId is provided, uploads the content as a new version of that existing file (in-place update) instead of creating a new file.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Alternative to localPath for clients without access to the server's filesystem. Provide either localPath or contentBase64.

convertToGoogleFormat.description: Convert uploaded file to Google Workspace format (e.g., .docx to Google Doc, .xlsx to Google Sheet, .pptx to Google Slides). Defaults to false. Not allowed with fileId.

fileId.description: ID of an existing Drive file to update in place: the uploaded content becomes a new version of this file (same ID, revision history preserved). Omit to create a new file.

localPath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload (on the machine running this server). Provide either localPath or contentBase64.

mimeType.description: MIME type (auto-detected from extension if omitted)

name.description: File name in Drive (defaults to local filename; required when creating a new file from contentBase64)

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder ID or path (e.g., '/Work/Projects'). Creates folders if needed. Defaults to root. Not allowed with fileId (use moveItem to move a file).

name: uploadFile
